newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-St Barbara order seen settling row.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-St Barbara order seen settling row.

text.p: A Western Australia court on Tuesday issued orders for the settlement of a long-running dispute over shareholdings in Bengal Star Pty Ltd, which holds a contolling interest in St Barbara Mines Ltd, St Barbara chairman Alan Birchmore said in a statement.
The order enables Birchmore and Bengal Star founder Ross Atkins to dispose of up to 19.9 percent in St Barbara, held in the name of Bengal Star, Birchmore said.
Bengal Star holds 53 percent of St Barbara.
Birchmore and Atkins have been in a dispute since Atkins was terminated as operations director of St Barbara more than a year ago.
Birchmore said the court ruling made it possible to sell the interest to a major new shareholder.
The task of finding the right buyer has been made easier by a turnaround at St Barbara, Birchmore said.
Resources at the Western Australia mine had risen by over 50 percent in the past 12 months to exceed three million ounces for the first time, he said.
